subject: Proposal to split Platform Reliability req (runtime vs platform) - request to open
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal to split Platform Reliability req (runtime vs platform) - request to open

Hi Laura / Marissa,

Quick note to propose we *split* an incoming SRE backfill into two focused reqs:
- Runtime Reliability Engineer (focus: model runtime, KV cache, latency regressions)
- Platform Stability Engineer (focus: infra observability, autoscale policies, cost SLOs)

Why now: recent incidents + projected Q3 model rollout increase show divergent skill needs. If we hire one generalist we risk long ramp and two bottlenecks in parallel workstreams. I ran a quick forecast and we can cover both roles by reallocating ~$120k from the Tools & Observability underspend for the year (attached).

Ask: approval to open 2 headcount reqs and to start intake + panel scheduling this week. If approved, Marissa can draft the JDs and open the jobs in Greenhouse; Laura, can you confirm hiring manager ownership for both? Markus, tagging you for band/finance sign-off.

Attachments: 20260530_budget_realloc_tools_to_hiring.xlsx, draft_jd_runtime_reliability.md, draft_jd_platform_stability.md

Proposed timeline: open reqs by Friday (5/30), intake meeting Mon/Tue, first onsites late-June.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal to split Platform Reliability req (runtime vs platform) - request to open

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick questions before I greenlight:
1) Can you confirm the funding reallocation won't impact any committed vendor contracts in Tools & Observability this fiscal year?
2) Which region will these roles be hired into (US / EU / remote)? I want to ensure we use the right salary bands.
3) Please include the job family and level recommendation (IC4/5/6) in the JD drafts.

If the answers are positive I'll route to Finance for formal budget sign-off. Markus — if you have immediate concerns on runway, flag them here. Marissa — once I approve HM ownership I expect a 30-minute intake to land scope.

-Laura
VP, Infrastructure
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal to split Platform Reliability req (runtime vs platform) - request to open

Laura — answers inline:
1) Tools & Observability: this is underspend from the monitoring pilot (no contracts impacted) — spreadsheet shows the line items removed. See tab "realloc".
2) Region: primary hire in US (remote OK), one role we can open as flexible EU/remote depending on candidates.
3) Levels: propose Runtime = IC4-5 (mostly IC5 target), Platform Stability = IC5 (occasionally IC6 for staff if exceptional). Draft JDs include suggested bands.

Neha, I looped you because you'll be the technical interviewer for Runtime. Can you confirm availability for 30-min intake tomorrow afternoon?

Marissa — if you can spin up the two draft GH job boards and the intake invite I'll schedule with Laura and Neha. I pushed the org chart to Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=org-chart-v2

Rishi
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal to split Platform Reliability req (runtime vs platform) - request to open

All —

I approve opening the reqs on the conditions below:
- Keep both roles within the IC5 salary band where possible (ok to backfill IC4 for Runtime if candidate mix requires).
- We require a diversity slate for both roles and at least one candidate from EU for the platform role.
- Marissa, include expected total comp ranges in the GH posting drafts and tag the reqs with the cost center: INF-PLATFORM-2026.

If those conditions are met, finance sign-off is good from my side. Rishi — please forward any org / runway changes immediately if hiring plan shifts.

-Markus
Head of Engineering Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, talentops@talentworks.com
Date: 2026-05-31T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal to split Platform Reliability req (runtime vs platform) - request to open

Thanks everyone — action items and next steps:
1) I will open two draft reqs in Greenhouse today using the attached JD drafts (draft_jd_runtime_reliability.md, draft_jd_platform_stability.md). Link to GH intake: https://greenhouse.example.com/boards/new?template=platform-reliability
2) Intake meeting: proposing Mon 6/1 10:00-10:30 or Tue 6/2 14:00-14:30 — please reply with preferred slot.
3) I'll add IC5 band ranges in the posting and mark cost center INF-PLATFORM-2026 per Markus.
4) Hiring panel: Laura (HM), Neha (tech), Rishi (product-context), + 1 cross-functional interviewer (TBD). I'll coordinate with talentops@talentworks.com for initial sourcing and ensure diversity slate.

Attachments: draft_jd_runtime_reliability.md, draft_jd_platform_stability.md

If no objections by EOD today I'll move to open the GH reqs and share the intake calendar invite.

-Marissa
Senior Technical Recruiter
